data.body:
Final debug report

Problem: the repository-local `.github/actions/setup-uv` composite action failed during PowerShell parsing before tests across Linux/macOS/Windows setup-dependent jobs.

Proven root cause: commit 5ff99170b5d0cf97f2f639f117f4b9337622ba33 added `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml` with the checksum mismatch throw `throw "Checksum mismatch for $asset: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash"` in a double-quoted PowerShell string. PowerShell parses `$asset:` as a scoped/drive-qualified variable token, not variable `$asset` plus literal colon, causing a ParserError before execution. The only non-scope offender was `$asset:`; `$env:RUNNER_OS`, `$env:RUNNER_ARCH`, `$env:RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE`, `$env:RUNNER_TEMP`, `$env:GITHUB_PATH`, and `$env:GITHUB_OUTPUT` are legitimate scoped references.

Proof: Test Suite (mirror) run 33574990286 at 5ff99170 failed in the setup action with `ParserError ... .ps1:51` and highlighted `$asset:`. Current `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml` uses `throw "Checksum mismatch for ${asset}: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash"`. Local guard scans show no remaining non-scope `$name:` hazards in the action. Since local `pwsh` is unavailable on this host, cross-OS execution proof is CI: Gerrit change 2501's Verify run 33575422978 passed; main Test Suite run 33578307020 reached the intended lint/typecheck and pytest commands after setup-uv installed uv on Linux, macOS, and Windows; later main Test Suite runs 33601203013 and 33632384491 were green. The prompt-eval workflow still uses the same local setup action (`.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml:68`), so it shares the fixed parser surface.

Defect origin: recorded `fab8-3a2b-d966-4e63 caused_by 5caa-4b63-7ea2-4e71`. Attribution evidence is commit 5ff99170 (`Install uv through local setup action`, `rebar-ticket: 5caa-4b63-7ea2-4e71`), which introduced both the local action and the offending throw. I attached the introducing commit to 5caa so the caused_by gate could record the proven origin without force.

Fix: Gerrit change 2501, merged as 024a6a2278134128be0c76c8d7c60e41b4ba817d, braced the interpolation to `${asset}:`, extended `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` with a portable guard for non-scope PowerShell `$name:` hazards, and added `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py::test_powershell_colon_interpolation_in_local_action_is_rejected`. Gerrit labels: LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, status MERGED. Follow-up Gerrit change 2524, merged as eaf91586ede36081253a6927f09fcf7db4e7c061, added the negative-control test `test_legitimate_powershell_scoped_variables_in_local_action_are_allowed`; labels LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, status MERGED.

Test evidence: targeted local tests passed (`tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` 19 passed; with release workflow pin tests 42 passed). `make lint` and `make typecheck` passed in the worktree venv. Mutation teeth: reintroducing `$asset:` made `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` fail with the expected `$asset:` finding; removing the legitimate-scope exclusion made the new `$env:` negative-control test fail, then restoring the code made it pass. Mutation runs were inside `sandbox-exec` with writes restricted to the worktree/scratch directory.

Scope & safety: caller/parity sweep found all setup-uv workflow call sites use `./.github/actions/setup-uv`; the fix is localized to the action plus its existing uv-pin guard/tests. It restores intended parsing/installation behavior, adds no dependency, and weakens no tests. Construct sweep found no additional non-scope `$name:` hazards in the local action. Structural guard disposition: warranted and implemented by extending the existing `make lint` uv-pin guard, which now fails on this exact class before CI setup can regress.

Replication: original ParserError no longer reproduces in CI; setup-uv successfully installs uv and jobs proceed to intended commands. Ticket was closed with `--class regression --caused-by=5caa-4b63-7ea2-4e71` against merged SHA eaf91586ede36081253a6927f09fcf7db4e7c061. Completion-verifier is certified (signed_at 1788373047067795000, material 10cbd9d9b8464825, principal b8a354e0-12c3-4cf2-bbf1-fcc9685d5126). Residual risk: none observed for this bug class.
